renew.title: Upload a new certificate – {store_name}
renew.form.heading: Upload a new certificate
renew.form.intro: Upload your new tax certificate for {store_name}. It will be reviewed before your tax exemption is renewed.
renew.form.fileHint: PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 5 MB.
renew.form.expiryHint: The date printed on the certificate, if it has one.
renew.form.sendingHint: Please keep this page open while your file uploads.
renew.done.heading: Thank you
renew.done.body: Your certificate was uploaded. {store_name} will review it and contact you if anything else is needed.
renew.invalid.heading: This link doesn't work
renew.invalid.body: Please use the link from your most recent email, or reply to that email to ask {store_name} for a new one.
renew.expired.heading: This link has expired
renew.expired.body: For your security, upload links work for a limited time. Reply to the email from {store_name} to ask for a new link.
renew.used.heading: This link was already used
renew.used.body: Each upload link works once. If you need to send another file, reply to the email from {store_name} to ask for a new link.
renew.rate.heading: Too many attempts
renew.rate.body: Please wait an hour and try again, or reply to the email from {store_name} for help.
renew.error.size: This file is larger than 5 MB. Please upload a smaller file.
renew.error.type: This file type isn't accepted. Please upload a PDF, JPG or PNG.
renew.error.date: Enter the expiry date as a full date.
renew.error.upload: We couldn't upload this file. Check that it's a real PDF, JPG or PNG and try again.
